Unless Declarant otherwise notifies the Board in writing at least 60 days before the beginning of each fiscal year, Declarant shall be deemed to have elected to continue paying on the same basis as during the immediately preceding fiscal year.

provisions.label: 8.7(b)/p2
provisions.text: Regardless of Declarant's election, Declarant's obligations hereunder may be satisfied in the form of cash or by "in kind" contributions of services or materials, or by a combination of these. After termination of the Class "B" Control Period, Declarant shall pay assessments on its unsold Units, and Declarant's Affiliates shall pay assessments on their Units, in the same manner as any other Owner.

provisions.label: 8.7(b)/p3
provisions.text: Declarant may make the election provided for under this Section 8.7(b) both with respect to Base Assessments and with respect to Neighborhood Assessments within any Neighborhood.

provisions.heading: Lien for Assessments
provisions.text: 8.8 Lien for Assessments.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or numbered items.

provisions.label: 8.8/p1
provisions.text: The Association shall have a lien against each Unit to secure payment of delinquent assessments, as well as interest, late charges (subject to the limitations of Washington law), and costs of collection (including attorneys' fees). Such lien shall be superior to all other liens, except (a) the liens of all taxes, bonds, assessments, and other levies which by law would be superior, and (b) the lien or charge of any Recorded first Mortgage (meaning any Recorded Mortgage with first priority over other Mortgages) made in good faith and for value. Such lien, when delinquent, may be enforced by suit, judgment, and judicial or nonjudicial foreclosure.

provisions.label: 8.8/p2
provisions.text: The Association may bid for the Unit at the foreclosure sale and acquire, hold, lease, mortgage, and convey the Unit. While a Unit is owned by the Association following foreclosure. (a) no right to vote shall be exercised on its behalf; (b) no assessment shall be levied on it; and (c) each other Unit shall be charged, in addition to its usual assessment, its pro rata share of the assessment that would have been charged such Unit had it not been acquired by the Association. The Association may sue for unpaid assessments and other charges authorized hereunder without foreclosing or waiving the lien securing the same.

provisions.label: 8.8/p3
provisions.text: Sale or transfer of any Unit shall not affect the assessment lien or relieve such Unit from the lien for any subsequent assessments. However, the sale or transfer of any Unit pursuant to foreclosure of the first Mortgage shall extinguish the lien as to any installments of such assessments due prior to the Mortgagee's foreclosure. The subsequent Owner to the foreclosed Unit shall not be personally liable for assessments on such Unit due prior to such acquisition of title. Such unpaid assessments shall be deemed to be Common Expenses collectible from Owners of all Units subject to assessment under Section 8.6, including such acquirer, its successors and assigns. In any event, such unpaid assessments shall remain the obligation of the defaulting Owner of the Unit, and the Association may sue for such unpaid assessments and other charges authorized hereunder.

provisions.heading: Exempt Property
provisions.text: 8.9 Exempt Property.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or numbered items.

provisions.label: 8.9/p1
provisions.text: The following property shall be exempt from payment of Base Assessments, Neighborhood Assessments, and Special Assessments.

provisions.label: 8.9(a)
provisions.text: All Common Area and other portions of the Residential Community which are not Units;

provisions.label: 8.9(b)
provisions.text: Any property dedicated or conveyed to and accepted by any governmental entity or public utility, and

provisions.label: 8.9(c)
provisions.text: Property owned by any Neighborhood Association for the common use and enjoyment of its members, or owned by the members of a Neighborhood Association as tenants-in-common.

provisions.label: 8.9/p2
provisions.text: In addition, Declarant and/or the Association shall have the right, but not the obligation, to grant exemptions certain Persons qualifying for tax exempt status under Section 501(c) of the Internal Revenue Code so long as such Persons own property subject to this Declaration for purposes listed in Section 501(c).

provisions.heading: Working Capital Fund
provisions.text: Each Owner who first acquires ownership of a Unit from the Declarant or an Affiliate, which Unit has been fully improved with a residence thereon (other than Declarant, an Affiliate, any grantee of Declarant's rights, or any Mortgagee) shall pay to the Association immediately upon becoming the Owner of the Unit a sum equal to one-half percent (.5%) of the total sales price of the Unit. Funds paid to the Association pursuant to this Section may be used by the Association for payment of operating expenses or any other purpose permitted under the Governing Documents. Payments made pursuant to this Section shall be nonrefundable and shall not be considered as an advance payment of any Assessments levied by the Association pursuant to this Declaration.

provisions.heading: Reserve Contribution
provisions.text: Each Owner who first acquires ownership of a Unit from the Declarant or an Affiliate, which Unit has been fully improved with a residence thereon (other than Declarant, an Affiliate, any grantee of Declarant's rights, or any Mortgagee) shall pay to the Association immediately upon becoming the Owner of the Unit a reserve contribution in the amount of $300.00. Funds paid to the Association pursuant to this Section shall be deposited in a Reserve Account established pursuant to Section 8.3. Payments made pursuant to this Section shall be nonrefundable and shall not be considered as an advance payment of any other assessments levied by the Association pursuant to this Declaration.

provisions.heading: Use and Consumption Fees; Facilities Membership Fees
provisions.text: The Board may charge use and consumption fees, or facilities membership fees, to any Person using Association services or facilities and may determine the amount and method of determining such fees. Different fees may be charged to different classes of users (e.g., Owners and non-Owners). Such fees shall be considered as assessments for all purposes under this Article, and the Association's assessment lien described in Section 8.8 shall include amounts due for such fees. In its discretion, the Board may condition the use of Common Area recreational facilities upon the payment of use and consumption fees, or facilities membership fees, regardless of whether such facilities previously were available for use without the payment of such fees.

provisions.heading: Transfer Fees
provisions.text: Each Owner shall pay to the Association, or to its managing agent, if directed to do so by the Board, immediately upon becoming the Owner of a Unit, a transfer fee in such amount as is established from time to time by the Board. The transfer fee shall reasonably approximate the administrative cost to the Association resulting from the transfer of a Unit from one Owner to another Owner.

provisions.label: part-four
provisions.heading: Community Development
provisions.text: This Declaration reserves various rights to the Declarant in order to facilitate the smooth and orderly development of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge and to accommodate changes in the Master Plan which will inevitably occur as a community the size of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge grows and matures.

noRule.note: Introduces Part Four: why the Declaration reserves development rights to the Declarant.

provisions.label: article-9
provisions.heading: Expansion of the Residential Community
provisions.text: Article 9 Expansion of the Residential Community

provisions.heading: Expansion by Declarant
provisions.text: 9.1 Expansion by Declarant.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 9.1/p1
provisions.text: Declarant may from time to time subject to the provisions of this Declaration all or any portion of the property described in Exhibit "B," including portions which are not contiguous to other portions of the Residential Community, by Recording a Supplemental Declaration describing the additional property to be subjected. A Supplemental Declaration Recorded pursuant to this Section shall not require the consent of any Person except the owner of such property, if other than Declarant.

provisions.label: 9.1/p2
provisions.text: Declarant's right to expand the Residential Community pursuant to this Section shall expire when all property described in Exhibit "B" has been subjected to this Declaration or 20 years after this Declaration is Recorded, whichever is earlier. Until then, Declarant may transfer or assign this right to any Person who is the developer of at least a portion of the real property described in Exhibit "A" or "B." Any such transfer shall be memorialized in a written, Recorded Instrument executed by Declarant.

provisions.label: 9.1/p3
provisions.text: Nothing in this Declaration shall be construed to require Declarant or any successor to subject additional property to this Declaration or to develop any of the property described in Exhibit "B" in any manner whatsoever.

noRule.note: The Declarant isn't obliged to annex or develop.

provisions.heading: Expansion by the Association
provisions.text: The Association may also subject additional property to the provisions of this Declaration by Recording a Supplemental Declaration describing the additional property. Any such Supplemental Declaration shall require the affirmative vote of Members representing more than 50% of the Association's Class "A" votes and the consent of the owner of the property. In addition, so long as Declarant or any Affiliate of Declarant owns any property described in Exhibits "A" or "B," Declarant's consent shall be necessary. The President and Secretary of the Association, the owner of the property, and Declarant, if Declarant's consent is necessary, shall sign the Supplemental Declaration.

provisions.heading: Additional Covenants and Easements
provisions.text: Declarant may subject any portion of the Residential Community to additional covenants and easements, including covenants obligating the Association to maintain and insure such property and authorizing the Association to recover its costs through Neighborhood Assessments. Such additional covenants and easements may be set forth either in a Supplemental Declaration subjecting such property to this Declaration or in a separate Supplemental Declaration referencing property previously subjected to this Declaration. If someone other than Declarant owns the property, then such owner's consent shall be necessary and shall be evidenced by the owner's execution of the Supplemental Declaration. Any such Supplemental Declaration may supplement, create exceptions to, or otherwise modify the terms of this Declaration as it applies to the subject property in order to reflect the different character and intended use of such property.

provisions.heading: Effect of Recording Supplemental Declaration
provisions.text: A Supplemental Declaration shall be effective upon Recording unless otherwise specified in such Supplemental Declaration. On the effective date of the Supplemental Declaration, any additional property subjected to this Declaration shall be assigned voting rights in the Association and assessment liability in accordance with the provisions of this Declaration.

noRule.note: When a Supplemental Declaration takes effect (its edition's effectiveFrom) and that annexed Units get votes and assessments like any other Unit.

provisions.label: article-10
provisions.heading: Additional Rights Reserved to Declarant
provisions.text: Article 10 Additional Rights Reserved to Declarant

provisions.heading: Withdrawal of Property
provisions.text: Declarant reserves the right to amend this Declaration, so long as Declarant or any Affiliate of Declarant owns any property described in Exhibit "A" or "B," for the purpose of removing from the coverage of this Declaration any portion of the Residential Community, provided such withdrawal does not unreasonably violate the overall scheme of development for the Master Plan. Such amendment shall not require the consent of any Person other than the owner(s) of the property to be withdrawn, if not Declarant; provided further, such amendment shall be subject to any required approval by King County or other Jurisdictions. If the property is Common Area, the Association shall take whatever action is required to effect the withdrawal.

provisions.heading: Right to Designate Sites for Governmental and Public Interests
provisions.text: 10.2 Right to Designate Sites for Governmental and Public Interests.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 10.2/p1
provisions.text: For so long as Declarant or any Affiliate of Declarant owns any property described in Exhibit "A" or "B," Declarant may, but is not obligated to, designate sites within the Residential Community for government, education, or religious activities and interests, including without limitation, fire, police, and utility facilities, schools and educational facilities, houses of worship, parks, and other public facilities. The sites may include Common Area, in which case the Association shall take whatever action is required to permit such use, including dedication or conveyance of the site, if so directed by Declarant.

provisions.label: 10.2/p2
provisions.text: Notwithstanding any provision in the Governing Documents to the contrary, except with respect to Article 11, this Declaration shall not apply to bind any portion of the Residential Community which is dedicated to and accepted by any governmental entity or public utility.

noRule.note: Dedicated property is outside the Declaration (except Article 11); that's the extent of the document's governs condition, and no Unit in a request is dedicated property.

provisions.heading: Marketing and Sales Activities and Materials
provisions.text: Declarant, its Affiliates and Builders authorized by Declarant shall have the right to maintain sales and leasing offices, management offices, construction offices, a design center, model homes, and parking areas throughout the Residential Community for the purpose of accommodating prospective Unit purchasers, and to maintain one or more advertising, identification, or directional signs on the Common Area or on the Units owned or leased by Declarant, its Affiliates, or Builders authorized by Declarant while such Persons are selling Units. Declarant reserves the right to (a) place sales and leasing offices, management offices, construction offices, a design center, model homes, and parking areas on any Units owned or leased by Declarant, its Affiliates, or Builders authorized by Declarant and on any portion of the Common Area in such number, of such size, and in such locations as Declarant deems appropriate, and (b) use any clubhouse and recreational facilities within the Residential Community for management and sales activities, including, without limitation, permitting the temporary use of such facilities by prospective purchasers. Declarant, its Affiliates, and authorized Builders shall have easements for access to and use of such facilities and shall not be subject to fees or rental charges.

provisions.heading: Right to Develop
provisions.text: Declarant and its Affiliates and their respective employees, agents, and designees shall have a right of access and use and an easement over and upon all of the Common Area for the purpose of making, constructing, and installing improvements to the Residential Community as it deems appropriate in its sole discretion, including the storage of tools, machinery, equipment, building materials, appliances, supplies, and fixtures, and the performance of work respecting the Residential Community, so long as such activities are not inconsistent with the permitted uses and purposes of the Common Areas as defined in the UPD Permit.

provisions.heading: Right to Approve Additional Covenants
provisions.text: No Person shall Record any declaration of covenants, conditions, and restrictions, or declaration of condominium or similar instrument affecting any portion of the Residential Community without Declarant's review and written consent so long as Declarant or any Affiliate of Declarant owns any property described in Exhibits "A" or "B." Thereafter, the Board must consent. Any instrument Recorded without such consent shall be void and of no force and effect unless Declarant or the Board, as applicable, subsequently approves in a Recorded consent document.

provisions.heading: Right to Approve Changes in the Standards Within the Residential Community
provisions.text: No amendment to or modification of any Use Restrictions or Residential Design Guidelines shall be effective without prior notice to and the written approval of Declarant so long as Declarant or any Affiliate of Declarant owns any property described in Exhibit "A" or "B."

provisions.heading: Community Systems and Services
provisions.text: 10.7 Community Systems and Services.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 10.7/p1
provisions.text: Declarant reserves for itself, its Affiliates, successors, and assignees, the exclusive and perpetual right to provide and operate, or to permit others (including, without limitation, the Association) to provide and operate within the Residential Community such telecommunication systems (including, without limitation, cable television, community Intranet, Internet, and other systems for receiving, distributing, and transmitting electronic data, signals, and audio or visual communications), security monitoring systems and services, utilities, and similar systems and services, and related equipment and infrastructure, including, without limitation, conduits, wires, amplifiers, towers, antennae, and other apparatus and equipment for the operation or provision thereof (collectively, the "Community Systems and Services") as Declarant, in its discretion, deems appropriate. Such right shall include, without limitation, the right to select and contract with companies licensed to provide such services in the Redmond Ridge area, and to charge individual users a reasonable fee not to exceed the maximum allowable charge for such service, as from time to time is defined by the laws, rules, and regulations of the relevant government authority, if applicable. Declarant and its Affiliates may receive, and shall be entitled to retain, any rebate, credit, fee, or incentive relating to the installation, operation, or provision of any Community Systems and Services. Notwithstanding the above reservation of rights, Declarant's exclusive and perpetual rights do not supersede King County's authority to regulate the public rights of way, including King County's authority to grant cable television and telecommunications franchises, permits or licenses in the public rights of way.

provisions.label: 10.7/p2
provisions.text: Declarant may require that the Board enter into agreements for the provision of Community Systems and Services to all Units as a Common Expense or Declarant may require that the cost for Community Systems and Services be charged through use and consumption fees if Declarant determines that the charges should not be paid by the Owners through Base Assessments. If particular services or benefits are provided to particular Owners or Units at their request, the benefited Owner(s) shall pay the service provider directly for such services, or the Association may assess the costs as a Specific Assessment. Non-use of services provided to all Owners or Units shall not exempt any Owner from the obligation to pay assessments for such services. Notwithstanding anything in this Declaration to the contrary, any contract or agreement entered into between Declarant or any of its Affiliates and a provider of Community Systems and Services shall be bona fide and commercially reasonable.

provisions.heading: Right to Transfer or Assign Declarant Rights
provisions.text: Any or all of Declarant's special rights and obligations set forth in this Declaration or the By-Laws may be transferred in whole or in part to other Persons; provided, the transfer shall not reduce an obligation nor enlarge a right beyond that which Declarant has under this Declaration or the By-Laws and shall not be inconsistent with the UPD Permit. No such transfer or assignment shall be effective unless it is in a Recorded instrument signed by Declarant, provided, Declarant may permit other Persons to exercise, on a one time or limited basis, any right reserved to Declarant in this Declaration where Declarant does not intend to transfer such right in its entirety, and in such case a Recorded assignment is not required.

provisions.heading: Easement to Inspect and Right to Correct
provisions.text: 10.9 Easement to Inspect and Right to Correct.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 10.9(a)
provisions.text: Declarant reserves for itself and its Affiliates and such other Persons as it may designate perpetual non-exclusive easements throughout the Residential Community to the extent reasonably necessary for the purposes of access, inspecting, testing, redesigning, or correcting any portion of the Residential Community, including Units and the Area of Common Responsibility. Declarant shall have the right to redesign or correct any part of the Area of Common Responsibility, and the designees or Affiliates of Declarant shall have the right to redesign, or correct any Unit or portion of a Neighborhood in which they were the Builder.

noRule.note: Reserves to the Declarant, its Affiliates and designees easements to inspect, test, redesign and correct; grants a right; no rule (its conditions are 10.9(b) and (c)).

provisions.label: 10.9(b)
provisions.text: Entry onto a Unit shall be after reasonable notice, except in an emergency. Entry into a structure on a Unit shall be only after Declarant or any of its Affiliates notifies the Unit's Owner and agrees with the Owner regarding a reasonable time to enter the structures on such Unit to perform such activities.

provisions.label: 10.9(c)
provisions.text: Any damage to a Unit or the Area of Common Responsibility resulting from the exercise of the easement or right of entry described in Subsections (a) and (b) of this Section shall promptly be repaired by, and at the expense of, the Person exercising the easement right. The exercise of these easements shall not unreasonably interfere with the use of any Unit and entry onto any Unit shall be made only after reasonable notice to the Owner or occupant.

provisions.heading: Right to Notice of Design or Construction Claims
provisions.text: No Person shall retain an expert for the purpose of inspecting the design or construction of any structures or improvements within Trilogy at Redmond Ridge in connection with or in anticipation of any potential or pending claim, demand, or litigation involving such design or construction unless Declarant and any Builder involved in the design or construction have been first notified in writing and given an opportunity to meet with the Owner of the property to discuss the Owner's concerns and conduct their own inspection.

provisions.heading: Termination of Rights
provisions.text: The rights contained in this Article shall not terminate until the earlier of (a) 30 years from the date this Declaration is Recorded, or (b) Recording by Declarant of a statement that all sales activity has ceased.

provisions.heading: Franchise, Use and Permit Obligations Unaffected
provisions.text: Declarant's rights under this Article shall not diminish the obligation to comply with all applicable laws, including, without limitation, the obligation to obtain a franchise, special use, and/or permit approval, if necessary.

provisions.label: part-five
provisions.heading: Property Rights Within the Residential Community
provisions.text:
PART FIVE: PROPERTY RIGHTS WITHIN THE RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITY

The nature of living in a planned community, with its wide array of properties and development types and as ongoing development activity, requires the creation of special property rights and provisions to address the needs and responsibilities of the Owners, Declarant, the Association, and others within or adjacent to the Residential Community.

noRule.note: Introduces the Part: why the Declaration creates these rights.

provisions.label: article-11
provisions.heading: Easements
provisions.text: Article 11 Easements

provisions.heading: Common Area
provisions.intro: Declarant grants to each Owner a nonexclusive right and easement of use, access, and enjoyment in and to the Common Area, subject to:

provisions.label: 11.1(i)
provisions.text: The Governing Documents and any other applicable covenants,

noRule.note: The Common Area easement is subject to the Governing Documents.

provisions.label: 11.1(ii)
provisions.text: Any Covenant to Share Costs and rights of Persons set forth therein, including, without limitation, the use rights in Common Area facilities benefiting the occupants of residential property to the south of Novelty Hill Road, which use rights shall comply with the requirements under the UPD,

noRule.note: The Common Area easement is subject to Covenants to Share Costs and the use rights they give others.

provisions.label: 11.1(iii)
provisions.text: Any restrictions or limitations contained in any deed conveying such property to the Association;

noRule.note: The Common Area easement is subject to restrictions in the deeds to the Association.

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)
provisions.intro: The Board's right to:

noRule.note: Its intro introduces the Board's powers in (A) to (G).

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(A)
provisions.text: adopt Board Rules and Regulations governing the use and enjoyment of the Common Area, including rules limiting the number of guests who may use the Common Area,

noRule.note: The Board's power to adopt Board Rules and Regulations for the Common Area, including guest limits; the rules it adopts are their own document.

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(B)
provisions.text: suspend the right of an Owner to use Common Area recreational facilities (1) for any period during which any charge against such Owner's Unit remains delinquent, and (2) for a period not to exceed 30 days for a single violation or for a longer period in the case of any continuing violation, of the Governing Documents after notice and a hearing pursuant to the By-Laws,

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(C)
provisions.text: impose and enforce membership requirements for particular uses or facilities and to impose membership, admission, initiation, or other use fees (in addition to assessments) for the use of any recreational facility situated upon the Common Area, regardless of whether such facilities previously were available for use without payment of such fees,

noRule.note: The Board's power to set membership requirements and charge use fees for recreational facilities; it overrides no rule.

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(D)
provisions.text: dedicate or transfer all or any part of the Common Area, subject to such approval requirements as may be set forth in this Declaration,

noRule.note: The Board's power to dedicate or transfer Common Area; the approvals it needs are stated elsewhere in the Declaration.

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(E)
provisions.text: permit use of any recreational facilities situated on the Common Area by persons other than Owners, their families, lessees, and guests as required under the UPD Permit or otherwise under terms the Board establishes (including pursuant to a lease of such facilities under negotiated terms), and designate other areas and facilities within the Area of Common Responsibility as open for the use and enjoyment of the public;

noRule.note: The Board's power to open recreational facilities to non-Owners and other areas to the public; it overrides no rule.

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(F)
provisions.text: permit use of any recreational facilities situated on the Common Area by owners, occupants, and their guests of other "Trilogy" communities pursuant to reciprocal agreements between the Association and such other Trilogy communities,

noRule.note: The Board's power to open recreational facilities to other Trilogy communities under reciprocal agreements; it overrides no rule.

provisions.label: 11.1(iv)(G)
provisions.text: mortgage, pledge, or hypothecate any or all of its real or personal property as security for money borrowed or debts incurred subject to any applicable approval requirements contained in this Declaration, and

noRule.note: The Board's power to mortgage or pledge Association property; the approvals it needs are stated elsewhere in the Declaration.

provisions.label: 11.1(v)
provisions.text: The rights of certain Owners to the exclusive use of those portions of the Common Area designated "Limited Common Areas," as described in Article 12.

noRule.note: Limited Common Areas are encoded from Article 12.

provisions.label: 11.1/p2
provisions.text: Any Owner may extend his or her right of use and enjoyment to the members of his or her family, lessees, and social invitees, as applicable, subject to reasonable regulation by the Board. An Owner who leases his or her Unit shall be deemed to have assigned all such rights to the lessee of such Unit for the period of the lease.

provisions.heading: Easements of Encroachment
provisions.text: Declarant grants reciprocal appurtenant easements of encroachment, and for maintenance and use of any permitted encroachment, between each Unit and any adjacent Common Area and between adjacent Units due to the unintentional placement or settling or shifting of the improvements constructed, reconstructed, or altered thereon (in accordance with the terms of these restrictions) to a distance of not more than three feet, as measured from any point on the common boundary along a line perpendicular to such boundary. However, in no event shall an easement for encroachment exist if such encroachment occurred due to willful and knowing conduct on the part of, or with the knowledge and consent of, the Person claiming the benefit of such easement.

noRule.note: Easements for unintentional encroachments of up to three feet between Units and the Common Area, never for willful ones; grants a right; no rule.

provisions.heading: Easements for Utilities, Etc
provisions.text: 11.3 Easements for Utilities, Etc.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)
provisions.heading: Installation and Maintenance
provisions.intro: Declarant reserves for itself, so long as Declarant or any Affiliate of Declarant owns any property described in Exhibit "A" or "B," on behalf of itself, its nominees, successors, and assigns, perpetual non-exclusive easements throughout the Residential Community (but not through a structure) to the extent reasonably necessary to

provisions.label: 11.3(a)(i)
provisions.text: install utilities and infrastructure to serve the Residential Community, Community Systems, including cable and other systems for sending and receiving data and/or other electronic signals, drainage systems, and security and similar systems,

noRule.note: A purpose of the Declarant's utility easement.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)(ii)
provisions.text: install walkways, pathways and trails, street lights, and signage on property which Declarant or the Association owns or within public rights-of-way or easements reserved for such purpose on a Recorded plat,

noRule.note: A purpose of the Declarant's utility easement.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)(iii)
provisions.text: inspect, maintain, repair, and replace the utilities, infrastructure, and other improvements described above

noRule.note: A purpose of the Declarant's utility easement.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)(iv)
provisions.text: access and read utility meters; and

noRule.note: A purpose of the Declarant's utility easement.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)(v)
provisions.text: access any wetland, body of water, or water monitoring site to perform water monitoring and testing.

noRule.note: A purpose of the Declarant's utility easement.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)/p2
provisions.text: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, this easement shall not entitle the holders to construct or install any of the foregoing systems, facilities, or utilities over, under or through any existing dwelling on a Unit, and any damage to a Unit resulting from the exercise of this easement shall promptly be repaired by, and at the expense of, the Person exercising the easement. Exercise of this easement shall not unreasonably interfere with the use of any Unit and, except in an emergency, entry onto any Unit shall be made only after reasonable notice to the Owner or occupant. Declarant's rights under this Section shall not diminish the obligation to comply with all applicable laws, including, without limitation, the obligation to obtain a special use, right-of-way and/or other Permit approvals, if necessary.

provisions.label: 11.3(a)/p3
provisions.text: No utilities may be installed or relocated on the Residential Community by Persons other than Declarant without Declarant's prior written consent so long as Declarant or any of its Affiliates owns any property described on Exhibits "A" or "B." Thereafter, the Board must consent to such installation or relocation of utilities. This provision shall not apply to governmental entities installing or relocating utilities.

provisions.label: 11.3(b)
provisions.heading: Community Systems and Services
provisions.text: Declarant reserves for itself, its Affiliates, and its nominees, successors, and assignees, perpetual, non-exclusive easements throughout the Residential Community for the purpose of installing, operating, maintaining, repairing, and replacing the Community Systems and Services (as described in Section 10.7). Declarant may grant, convey, or assign, in whole or in part, their easement rights hereunder to any Person, including, without limitation, the Association.

noRule.note: Reserves to the Declarant easements for Community Systems and Services, which it may assign; grants a right; no rule.

provisions.label: 11.3(c)
provisions.heading: Specific Easements
provisions.text: Declarant also reserves for itself the non-exclusive right and power to grant and Record such specific easements as may be necessary, in Declarant's sole discretion, for the orderly development of any property described in Exhibits "A" and "B." The location of the easement shall be subject to the written approval of the owner of the burdened property, which approval shall not unreasonably be withheld, delayed, or conditioned. This provision shall not apply to property owned by governmental entities.

provisions.label: 11.3(d)
provisions.heading: Minimal Interference
provisions.text: All work associated with the exercise of the easements described in this Section shall be performed in such a manner as to minimize interference with the use and enjoyment of the property burdened by the easement. Upon completion of the work, the Person exercising the easement shall restore the property, to the extent reasonably possible, to the condition existing prior to the work. The exercise of these easements shall not extend to permitting entry into the structures on any Unit, nor shall it unreasonably interfere with the use of any Unit and, except in an emergency, entry onto any Unit shall be made only after reasonable notice to the Owner or occupant.

provisions.heading: Easements for Development
provisions.text: 11.4 Easements for Development.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 11.4/p1
provisions.text: Declarant reserves for itself, its Affiliates, and its duly authorized agents, successors, assigns, and mortgagees, an easement over the Common Area for enjoyment, use, access, and development of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge, including portions not subject to this Declaration. This easement includes, but is not limited to, a right of ingress and egress over the Common Area for (a) making, constructing, and installing improvements (within the Common Areas and elsewhere), as it deems appropriate in its discretion, (b) construction of roads, and (c) connecting and installing utilities. Declarant agrees that it and its successors or assigns shall be responsible for any damage caused to the Common Area as a result of their actions in connection with development of such property.

provisions.label: 11.4/p2
provisions.text: If the above easement grants permanent access to any property which is not submitted to this Declaration, Declarant, its Affiliates, or its successors or assigns, shall enter into a reasonable agreement with the Association to share the cost of maintenance that the Association provides for the benefit of the easement holder. The shared maintenance costs may include maintenance to or along any roadway providing access to the benefited property.

provisions.heading: Easements for Maintenance, Emergency, and Enforcement
provisions.text: Declarant grants to the Association easements over the Residential Community as necessary to enable the Association to fulfill its maintenance responsibilities under Section 7.2. The Association shall also have the right, but not the obligation, to enter upon any Unit for emergency, security, and safety reasons, to perform maintenance and to inspect for the purpose of ensuring compliance with and enforcing the Governing Documents. Any member of the Board and its duly authorized agents and assignees, and all emergency personnel in the performance of their duties may exercise such right. Except in an emergency situation, entry shall only be during reasonable hours and after notice to the Owner.

provisions.heading: Easement for Maintenance by Owners
provisions.text: If a fence or wall or other structure approved by the Declarant or the Design Review Committee is located along a boundary line (but not on the boundary line) of a Unit or Common Area and entry upon the adjacent Unit or Common Area is necessary for the Owner of such structure to maintain, repair and replace the structure, an easement for such entry onto the adjacent Unit or Common Area exists in favor of the Owner of the structure. Any damage to an adjacent Unit or Common Area resulting from the exercise of any easement rights granted in this Section shall be promptly restored or repaired by, and at the expense of, the Owner exercising the easement rights.

provisions.heading: Private Easements for Roadways and Utilities
provisions.text: 11.7 Private Easements for Roadways and Utilities.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 11.7/p1
provisions.text: Private ingress, egress and utilities easements (the "Private Roadway and Utility Easements") have been and will be granted and conveyed on the Recorded plats of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge to utility providers over, under and across certain Units, as shown on the Recorded plats, for the construction and maintenance of utilities together with the right of ingress and egress to such utilities. Every Owner, for the benefit of such Owner and occupants of the Unit and their guests, families, tenants and invitees, shall have a right and easement for ingress and egress for pedestrian and vehicular traffic over, through and across any Private Roadway and Utility Easement necessary to gain access to the Owner's Unit, which right and easement shall be appurtenant to and shall pass with the title to every Unit.

provisions.label: 11.7/p2
provisions.text: Each Owner shall maintain, repair and replace in accordance with the Community-Wide Standard (i) all paving improvements lying within the Private Roadway and Utility Easement on such Owner's Unit, and (ii) all private sanitary sewer lines, water lines and storm drain pipes and appurtenant facilities and all other utility improvements lying within the Private Roadway and Utility Easement on such Owner's Unit that are not maintained by a utility company, provided, however, if a sanitary sewer line, water line or storm drain pipe serves more than one Unit, then the Owners of all Units being served from such utility line shall share equally in the cost of maintaining such utility line. If any improvement or utility line within a private Roadway and Utility Easement is damaged or destroyed through the act of an Owner, it shall be the obligation of such Owner to rebuild and repair the improvement or utility line without cost to the other Owner or Owners.

provisions.heading: Easements for Golf Course
provisions.text: 11.8 Easements for Golf Course.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 11.8(a)
provisions.text: The Residential Community is burdened with an easement permitting golf balls unintentionally to travel over and come upon areas adjacent to a golf course, and for golfers at reasonable times and in a reasonable manner to come upon the Common Area and the exterior portions of any Unit to retrieve errant golf balls; provided, if any Unit is fenced or walled, entry on the Unit shall require the Unit Owner's permission. The existence of this easement shall not relieve golfers of liability for damage caused by errant golf balls.

provisions.label: 11.8(a)/p2
provisions.text: Under no circumstances shall any of the following Persons be held liable for any damage, nuisance, injury, or death resulting from errant golf balls or the exercise of this easement: Declarant, Affiliates of Declarant; the Association or its Members (in their capacities as such), the owner, operator, or lessee of any golf course, or their assigns, any Builder or contractor (in their capacities as such), any governmental entity or utility; any employee, officer, director, or partner of any of the foregoing, or any employee, officer, or director of any partner.

provisions.label: 11.8(b)
provisions.text: The owner of any golf course within or immediately adjacent to the Residential Community, its agents, successors, and assigns, shall at all times have a right and non-exclusive easement of access and use over those portions of the Common Areas reasonably necessary to the operation, maintenance, repair, and replacement of the golf course.

noRule.note: An easement over the Common Area for the golf course owner's operation and maintenance; grants a right; no rule.

provisions.label: 11.8(c)
provisions.text: Any portion of the Residential Community immediately adjacent to a golf course is burdened with a non-exclusive easement for overspray of water from the golf course's irrigation system. Under no circumstances shall Declarant or its Affiliates, the Association, or the golf course owner or operator be held liable for any damage or injury resulting from such overspray or the exercise of this easement.

provisions.heading: Applicable Law; Permits
provisions.text: The exercise of any rights pursuant to the easements granted or reserved in this Article 11 shall be subject to all provisions of applicable law including, without limitation, any requirement to obtain a franchise, [illegible] authorization, building permit or other permit approval from any governmental entity with an ownership interest in affected property or jurisdiction in connection with the exercise of such rights.

provisions.label: article-12
provisions.heading: Limited Common Areas
provisions.text: Article 12 Limited Common Areas

provisions.heading: Purpose
provisions.text: Certain portions of the Common Area may be designated as Limited Common Area and reserved for the exclusive use or primary benefit of all or any Owners and occupants within a particular Neighborhood or Neighborhoods. By way of illustration and not limitation, Limited Common Areas may include entry features, private streets, landscaped medians and cul-de-sacs, lakes, and other portions of the Common Area within a particular Neighborhood or Neighborhoods. The costs associated with maintenance, repair, replacement, and insurance of a Limited Common Area shall be allocated among the Owners to which the Limited Common Areas are assigned.

provisions.heading: Designation
provisions.text: 12.2 Designation.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 12.2/p1
provisions.text: Initially, any Limited Common Area shall be designated as such in a Supplemental Declaration, the deed conveying such area to the Association, or on a Recorded plat; provided, any such assignment shall not preclude Declarant from later assigning use of the same Limited Common Area to additional Units and/or Neighborhoods, so long as Declarant or any of its Affiliates own any of the property described on Exhibits "A" or "B."

provisions.label: 12.2/p2
provisions.text: Thereafter, a portion of the Common Area may be assigned as Limited Common Area and Limited Common Area may be reassigned upon approval of the Board and the vote of Members representing a majority of the Association's Class "A" votes, including a majority of the Class "A" votes within the Neighborhood(s) affected by the proposed assignment or reassignment.

provisions.heading: Use by Others
provisions.text: Upon approval of a majority of Owners of Units to which a Limited Common Area is assigned, the Association may permit Owners of other Units to use all or a portion of such Limited Common Area upon payment of reasonable user fees, which fees shall be used to offset the expenses attributable to such Limited Common Area.

provisions.label: article-13
provisions.heading: Party Walls and Other Shared Structures
provisions.text: Article 13 Party Walls and Other Shared Structures

provisions.heading: General Rules of Law to Apply
provisions.text: Each wall, fence, driveway, or similar structure built as a part of the original construction on the Units which serves and/or separates any two adjoining Units shall constitute a party structure. To the extent not inconsistent with the provisions of this Section or a Supplemental Declaration governing the party structure, the general rules of law regarding party walls and liability for property damage due to negligence or willful acts or omissions shall apply thereto. Any dispute arising concerning a party structure shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 14.

provisions.heading: Maintenance; Damage and Destruction
provisions.text: 13.2 Maintenance; Damage and Destruction.

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs or lettered items.

provisions.label: 13.2/p1
provisions.text: Unless otherwise specifically provided in a Supplemental Declaration, the Owners sharing the party structure shall share the cost of necessary or appropriate party structure repairs and maintenance equally.

provisions.label: 13.2/p2
provisions.text: If a party structure is destroyed or damaged by fire or other casualty, then to the extent that such damage is not covered by insurance and repaired out of the proceeds of insurance, any Owner of a Unit which shares the party structure may restore it. Other Owners of Units which share the structure shall contribute to the restoration cost in equal proportions. However, such contribution will not prejudice the right to call for a larger contribution from others under any rule of law regarding liability for negligent or willful acts or omissions.

provisions.label: 13.2/p3
provisions.text: The right of any Owner to contribution from any other Owner under this Section shall be appurtenant to the land and shall pass to such Owner's successors-in-title.

noRule.note: The right to contribution passes with the land; whoever owns the Unit when the work is done is the Owner the 13.2 rules bind.

provisions.label: part-six
provisions.heading: Relationships Within and Outside the Residential Community
provisions.text:
PART SIX: RELATIONSHIPS WITHIN AND OUTSIDE THE RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITY

The growth and success of the Residential Community as a place where people enjoy living, working, and playing requires good faith efforts to resolve disputes amicably, attention to and understanding of relationships within the Residential Community and with our neighbors, and protection of the rights of others who have an interest in the Residential Community.

noRule.note: Introduces the Part: why the Declaration creates these rights.

provisions.label: article-14
provisions.heading: Dispute Resolution and Limitation on Litigation
provisions.text: Article 14 Dispute Resolution and Limitation on Litigation

provisions.heading: Consensus for Association Litigation
provisions.text: Except as provided in this Section, after the Class "B" Control Period, the Association shall not commence a judicial or administrative proceeding without the approval of Members representing at least 67% of the Association's Class "A" votes. This Section shall not apply, however, to (a) actions brought by the Association to enforce the Governing Documents (including, without limitation, the foreclosure of liens); (b) the collection of assessments, (c) proceedings involving challenges to ad valorem taxation, (d) counterclaims brought by the Association in proceedings instituted against it, or (e) actions brought by the Association against any contractor or vendor arising out of a contract for services or supplies between the Association and such contractor or vendor. This Section shall not be amended unless such amendment is approved by the percentage of votes, and pursuant to the same procedures, necessary to institute proceedings as provided above.

provisions.heading: Alternative Method for Resolving Disputes
provisions.text: Declarant and its Affiliates, the Association, its officers, directors, and committee members, all Persons subject to this Declaration, any Builder, and any Person not otherwise subject to this Declaration who agrees to submit to this Article (collectively, "Bound Parties") agree to encourage the amicable resolution of disputes involving the Residential Community, without the emotional and financial costs of litigation. Accordingly, each Bound Party covenants and agrees to submit those claims, grievances, or disputes described in Section 14.3 ("Claims") to the procedures set forth in Section 14.4 in lieu of filing suit in any court.

provisions.heading: Claims
provisions.text: 14.3 Claims

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs.

provisions.label: 14.3/p1
provisions.text: Unless specifically exempted below, all Claims arising out of or relating to the interpretation, application, or enforcement of the Governing Documents, or the rights, obligations, and duties of any Bound Party under the Governing Documents or relating to the design or construction of improvements within the Residential Community shall be subject to the provisions of Section 14.4.

provisions.label: 14.3/p2
provisions.text: Notwithstanding the above, unless all parties thereto otherwise agree, the following shall not be Claims and shall not be subject to the provisions of Section 14.4.

provisions.label: 14.3(a)
provisions.text: any Association action to collect assessments or other amounts due from any Owner;

provisions.label: 14.3(b)
provisions.text: any Association action to obtain a temporary restraining order (or emergency equitable relief) and such ancillary relief as the court may deem necessary in order to maintain the status quo and preserve the Association's ability to enforce the provisions of Part Two of this Declaration (relating to creation and maintenance of community standards),

provisions.label: 14.3(c)
provisions.text: any dispute which affects the material rights or obligations of a party who is not a Bound Party and has not agreed to submit to the procedures set forth in Section 14.4,

provisions.label: 14.3(d)
provisions.text: any suit as to which the applicable statute of limitations would expire within 180 days of giving the Notice required by Section 14.4(a), unless the party or parties against whom the Claim is made agree to toll, or extend, the Claim's statute of limitations to comply with this Article,

provisions.label: 14.3(e)
provisions.text: any suit between Owners, which does not include Declarant, an Affiliate of Declarant, or the Association as a party,

provisions.label: 14.3(f)
provisions.text: any suit or dispute between an Owner or Owners and a Builder or Builders with respect to any (i) statutory or implied warranty, (ii) contractual warranty, or (iii) construction defect claim, and

provisions.label: 14.3(g)
provisions.text: any suit or dispute involving a governmental entity as a party.

provisions.label: 14.3/p3
provisions.text: With the consent of all parties thereto, any of the above may be submitted to the alternative dispute resolution procedures set forth in Section 14.4.

provisions.heading: Mandatory Procedures
provisions.text: 14.4 Mandatory Procedures

noRule.note: Its text is in its lettered items.

provisions.label: 14.4(a)
provisions.heading: Notice
provisions.intro: Any Bound Party having a Claim ("Claimant") against any other Bound Party ("Respondent") (collectively, the "Parties") shall notify each Respondent in writing (the "Notice"), stating plainly and concisely

provisions.label: 14.4(a)(i)
provisions.text: the nature of the Claim, including the Persons involved and Respondent's role in the Claim,

provisions.label: 14.4(a)(ii)
provisions.text: the legal basis of the Claim (i.e., the specific authority out of which the Claim arises);

provisions.label: 14.4(a)(iii)
provisions.text: Claimant's proposed remedy; and

provisions.label: 14.4(a)(iv)
provisions.text: that Claimant will meet with Respondent to discuss in good faith ways to resolve the Claim.

provisions.label: 14.4(b)
provisions.heading: Negotiation and Mediation
provisions.text: Negotiation and Mediation.

noRule.note: Its text is in its numbered items.

provisions.label: 14.4(b)(i)
provisions.text: The Parties shall make every reasonable effort to meet in person and confer for the purpose of resolving the Claim by good faith negotiation. If requested in writing, accompanied by a copy of the Notice, the Board may appoint a representative to assist the Parties in negotiation.

provisions.label: 14.4(b)(ii)
provisions.text: If the Parties do not resolve the Claim within 30 days of the date of the Notice (or within such other period as may be agreed upon by the Parties) ("Termination of Negotiations"), Claimant shall have 30 additional days to submit the Claim to mediation under the auspices of any King County dispute resolution center or, if the Parties otherwise agree, to an independent agency providing dispute resolution services in the area.

provisions.label: 14.4(b)(iii)
provisions.text: If Claimant does not submit the Claim to mediation within such time, or does not appear for and participate in good faith in the mediation, Claimant shall be deemed to have waived the Claim, and Respondent shall be released and discharged from any and all liability to Claimant on account of such Claim, provided, nothing herein shall release or discharge Respondent from any liability to any Person other than the Claimant.

provisions.label: 14.4(b)(iv)
provisions.text: Any settlement of the Claim through mediation shall be documented in writing by the mediator and signed by the Parties. If the Parties do not settle the Claim within 30 days after submission of the matter to the mediation, or such other time as the mediator deems sufficient, the mediator shall issue a notice of termination of the mediation proceedings ("Termination of Mediation"). The Termination of Mediation notice shall set forth that the Parties are at an impasse and the date that mediation was terminated. The Claimant shall thereafter be entitled to file suit or to initiate administrative proceedings on the Claim, as appropriate.

provisions.label: 14.4(b)(v)
provisions.text: Each Party shall bear its own costs, including attorneys' fees, and each Party shall share equally all fees charged by the mediator(s).

provisions.heading: Enforcement of Resolution
provisions.text: If the Parties agree to a resolution of any Claim through negotiation or mediation in accordance with Section 14.4 and any Party thereafter fails to abide by the terms of such agreement, then any abiding, or complying Party may file suit or initiate administrative proceedings to enforce such agreement without the need to again comply with the procedures set forth in Section 14.4. In such event, the Party taking action to enforce the agreement shall be entitled to recover from the non-complying Party (or if more than one non-complying Party, from all such Parties pro rata) all costs incurred in enforcing such agreement, including, without limitation, attorneys' fees and court costs.

provisions.label: article-15
provisions.heading: Private Amenities
provisions.text: Article 15 Private Amenities

provisions.heading: Right to Use the Private Amenities
provisions.text: Neither membership in the Association nor ownership or occupancy of a Unit shall automatically confer any right to use any Private Amenity. Rights to use any Private Amenity, and the terms and conditions of use, are determined only by the Private Amenity owner. Any Private Amenity owner shall have the right, from time to time, in its sole and absolute discretion and without notice, to cease operations or to amend or waive the terms and conditions relating to use of the Private Amenity, including, without limitation, eligibility for and duration of use rights, categories of use, extent of use privileges, and number of users, and shall also have the right to reserve use rights and to terminate use rights altogether, subject to the terms of any written membership agreements or documents. Use rights in or membership in any Private Amenity may be available to the general public, as determined in the Private Amenity owner's sole and absolute discretion.

noRule.note: Owning a Unit gives no right to use a Private Amenity; its owner sets and changes the terms of use.

provisions.heading: Operations; Conveyance of Private Amenities
provisions.text: 15.2 Operations; Conveyance of Private Amenities

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs.

provisions.label: 15.2/p1
provisions.text: All Persons, including all Owners, are advised that no representations or warranties have been or are authorized by Declarant, any Affiliate of Declarant, the Association, any Builder, or by any Person acting on behalf of any of the foregoing, with regard to the continuing ownership, operation, use, management, or membership structure of any Private Amenity. No purported representation or warranty in such regard, either written or oral, shall be effective unless specifically set forth in a written instrument executed by the Record owner of any Private Amenity.

noRule.note: No representations about the Private Amenities' ownership or operation.

provisions.label: 15.2/p2
provisions.text: The ownership, operation, use, or management of any Private Amenity (or any portion of a Private Amenity) may change at any time by virtue of, without limitation, (a) the sale to or assumption of operations or management by an independent Person, (b) establishment of, or conversion of the membership structure to, an "equity" club or similar arrangement whereby the Private Amenity members or an entity owned or controlled by its members become the Private Amenity owner(s) and/or operator(s), (c) the conveyance of the Private Amenity to one or more of Declarant's Affiliates, shareholders, employees, or independent contractors, or (d) the operation of the Private Amenity as a commercial enterprise open to the public. Consent of the Association or any Owner shall not be required to effectuate any change in ownership or operation of any Private Amenity, for or without consideration and subject to or free of any mortgage, covenant, lien, or other encumbrance.

noRule.note: A Private Amenity's ownership or operation may change without the Association's or any Owner's consent.

provisions.heading: Assumption of Risk and Indemnification
provisions.text: 15.3 Assumption of Risk and Indemnification

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs.

provisions.label: 15.3/p1
provisions.text: By purchasing a Unit in the vicinity of a golf course or other Private Amenity, each Owner expressly assumes the risk of noise, personal injury, death, or property damage caused by maintenance and operation of such Private Amenity, including, without limitation. (a) noise from maintenance equipment (it being specifically understood that maintenance typically takes place around sunrise or sunset), (b) noise caused by golfers and other Private Amenity users, (c) use of pesticides, herbicides, and fertilizers; (d) use of effluent in irrigation, (e) reduction in privacy caused by traffic (including non-residents of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge) to or from the Private Amenity, golf traffic on the golf course, or the removal or pruning of shrubbery or trees on the golf course; (f) errant golf balls and golf clubs; (g) the risk of water hazards and other improvements on the golf course which may be attractive nuisances to children, and (h) design or redesign of the golf course.

provisions.label: 15.3/p2
provisions.text: Each Owner agrees that Declarant, the Association, any Private Amenity owner(s), and any of Declarant's Affiliates or agents shall have no liability (including, without limitation, strict liability) to any Owner or any other Person claiming any loss or damage, including, without limitation, indirect, special, or consequential loss or damage arising from personal injury, death, destruction of property, trespass, loss of enjoyment, or any other alleged wrong or entitlement to remedy based upon, due to, arising from, or otherwise related to the proximity of Owner's Unit to the golf course or other Private Amenity, including, without limitation, any claim arising in whole or in part from the negligence of Declarant, any of Declarant's Affiliates or agents, or the Association. Each Owner agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Declarant, Declarant's Affiliates and agents, and the Association against any and all such claims by Owner's visitors, tenants, and others upon such Owner's Unit.

provisions.heading: Rights of Access and Parking
provisions.text: There is established for the benefit of any Private Amenity and its members (regardless of whether such members are Owners hereunder), guests, invitees, employees, agents, contractors, and designees, a right and non-exclusive easement of access and use over all roadways and golf cart paths, if any, located within the Residential Community which are reasonably necessary to travel between an entrance to the Residential Community and the Private Amenity and over those portions of the Residential Community (whether Common Area or otherwise) reasonably necessary to the operation, maintenance, repair, and replacement of the Private Amenity. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, subject to applicable parking restriction laws, Private Amenity members, guests, and invitees shall have the right to park their vehicles on roads located within the Residential Community at reasonable times before, during, and after tournaments and other member or public functions held by or at the Private Amenity to the extent that the Private Amenity has insufficient parking to accommodate such vehicles.

provisions.heading: Limitations on Amendments
provisions.text: In recognition of the fact that the provisions of this Article are for the benefit of the Private Amenities, no amendment to this Article, and no amendment in derogation of any other provisions of this Declaration benefiting any Private Amenity, may be made without the affected Private Amenity owner's written approval. The foregoing shall not apply, however, to amendments made by Declarant.

provisions.heading: Jurisdiction and Cooperation
provisions.text: Declarant intends that the Association and the Private Amenities shall cooperate to the maximum extent possible in the operation of the Residential Community and the Private Amenities. Each shall reasonably assist the other in upholding the Community-Wide Standard as it pertains to maintenance and the Residential Design Guidelines. The Association shall have no power to promulgate Use Restrictions affecting activities on or use of any Private Amenity without the affected Private Amenity owner's prior written consent.

provisions.label: article-16
provisions.heading: Mortgagee Provisions
provisions.text: The following provisions are for the benefit of holders, insurers, and guarantors of first Mortgages on Units in the Residential Community. The provisions of this Article apply to both this Declaration and to the By-Laws, notwithstanding any other provisions contained therein.

noRule.note: Whom Article 16 benefits, and that it also governs the By-Laws.

provisions.heading: Notices of Action
provisions.intro: An institutional holder, insurer, or guarantor of a first Mortgage which provides a written request to the Association (such request to state the name and address of such holder, insurer, or guarantor and the street address of the Unit to which its Mortgage relates, thereby becoming an "Eligible Holder"), will be entitled to timely written notice of:

provisions.label: 16.1(a)
provisions.text: Any condemnation loss or any casualty loss which affects a material portion of the Residential Community or which affects any Unit on which there is a first Mortgage held, insured, or guaranteed by such Eligible Holder,

provisions.label: 16.1(b)
provisions.text: Any delinquency in the payment of assessments or charges owed by a Unit subject to the Mortgage of such Eligible Holder, where such delinquency has continued for a period of 60 days, or any other violation of the Governing Documents relating to such Unit or the Owner or Occupant which is not cured within 60 days,

provisions.label: 16.1(c)
provisions.text: Any lapse, cancellation, or material modification of any insurance policy maintained by the Association, or

provisions.label: 16.1(d)
provisions.text: Any proposed action which would require the consent of a specified percentage of Eligible Holders.

provisions.heading: No Priority
provisions.text: No provision of this Declaration or the By-Laws gives or shall be construed as giving any Owner or other party priority over any rights of the first Mortgagee of any Unit in the case of distribution to such Owner of insurance proceeds or condemnation awards for losses to or a taking of the Common Area.

provisions.heading: Notice to Association
provisions.text: Upon request, each Owner shall be obligated to furnish to the Association the name and address of the holder of any Mortgage encumbering such Owner's Unit.

provisions.heading: Failure of Mortgagee To Respond
provisions.text: Any Mortgagee who receives a written request from the Board to respond to or consent to any action shall be deemed to have approved such action if the Association does not receive a written response from the Mortgagee within 30 days of the date of the Association's request, provided such request is delivered to the Mortgagee by certified or registered mail, return receipt requested.

provisions.label: article-17
provisions.heading: Disclosures and Waivers
provisions.text: Article 17 Disclosures and Waivers

provisions.heading: Changes in the Master Plan
provisions.text: Every Person that acquires any interest in Trilogy at Redmond Ridge acknowledges that Trilogy at Redmond Ridge is a master planned community, the development of which is likely to extend over many years, and agrees not to protest, challenge, or otherwise object to (a) changes in uses or density of undeveloped property within Trilogy at Redmond Ridge, or (b) changes in the Master Plan as such changes relate to property outside Trilogy at Redmond Ridge.

provisions.heading: Security
provisions.text: 17.2 Security

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs.

provisions.label: 17.2/p1
provisions.text: The Association may, but shall not be obligated to, maintain or support certain activities within the Residential Community designed to make the Residential Community safer than it otherwise might be. Neither the Association nor Declarant or its Affiliates shall in any way be considered insurers or guarantors of security within the Residential Community, and neither the Association nor Declarant or its Affiliates shall have any liability (including, without limitation, strict liability) for any loss or damage by reason of failure to provide adequate security or ineffectiveness of security measures undertaken.

provisions.label: 17.2/p2
provisions.text: No representation or warranty is made that any systems or measures, including any mechanism or system for limiting access to the Residential Community, cannot be compromised or circumvented, nor that any such systems or security measures undertaken will in all cases prevent loss or provide the detection or protection for which the system is designed or intended. Each Owner acknowledges, understands, and covenants to inform its tenants and all occupants of its Unit that the Association, its Board and committees, Declarant, and its Affiliates are not insurers and that each Person using the Residential Community assumes all risks of personal injury and loss or damage to property, including Units and the contents of Units, resulting from acts of third parties.

provisions.heading: View Impairment
provisions.text: 17.3 View Impairment

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs.

provisions.label: 17.3/p1
provisions.text: Neither Declarant nor the Association guarantee or represent that any view over and across the Units, any open space within the Residential Community, or any golf course or other Private Amenity will be preserved without impairment. Neither Declarant, Declarant's Affiliates, nor the Association nor any Private Amenity owner shall be obligated to relocate, prune, or thin trees or other landscaping except to maintain the Community-Wide Standard or as otherwise required under a separate covenant or agreement. The Association (with respect to the Common Area) and Private Amenity owners (with respect to Private Amenity property) have the right to add trees and other landscaping from time to time subject to applicable law. Any express or implied easements for view purposes or for the passage of light and air are hereby expressly disclaimed.

noRule.note: No view is guaranteed and no view easement exists.

provisions.label: 17.3/p2
provisions.text: Any golf course owner may, in its discretion, but shall not be obligated to, change the location, landscaping, topography, hydrology, configuration, size, and elevation of the tees, bunkers, fairways, greens, buildings, improvements, landscaping and water bodies on such golf course from time to time. Any such additions or changes to such golf course may diminish or obstruct the view from the Units.

noRule.note: A golf course owner may change the course, even if views suffer.

provisions.heading: Notices and Disclaimers as to Community Systems and Services
provisions.text: In recognition of the fact that interruptions in cable television and other Community Systems and Services (as defined in Section 10.7) will occur from time to time, neither Declarant, Declarant's Affiliates, nor any of their respective successors or assigns shall in any manner have liability (including, without limitation, strict liability) for, and no Community System or Service user shall be entitled to refund, rebate, discount, or offset in applicable fees, for any interruption in Community Systems and Services, regardless of whether or not such interruption is caused by reasons within the service provider's control.

provisions.heading: Notices and Disclaimers as to Indigenous Animals
provisions.text: The Residential Community is located in an area which may contain many species of insects, reptiles, and other animals. Animals indigenous to the area, including, without limitation, snakes, spiders, hawks, bears, cougars, and coyotes, may be found throughout the natural areas of the Residential Community and may enter upon the residential and recreational portions of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge from time to time. Owners, tenants, and residents, for themselves and their families, invitees, and licensees, assume the risk that such animals may be present and may present danger. Each Owner agrees that neither Declarant, the Association, nor any of Declarant's Affiliates or agents shall have any liability (including, without limitation, strict liability) to any Owner or any other Person claiming any loss or damage, including, without limitation, indirect, special, or consequential loss or damage arising from personal injury, death, destruction of property, trespass, loss of enjoyment, or any other alleged wrong or entitlement to remedy based upon, due to, arising from, or otherwise related to the proximity of Owner's Unit to the natural areas, including, without limitation, any claim arising in whole or in part from the negligence of Declarant, any of Declarant's Affiliates or agents, or the Association. Each Owner agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Declarant, Declarant's Affiliates and agents, and the Association against any and all such claims by Owners' visitors, tenants, and others upon such Owner's Unit.

provisions.heading: Notices and Disclaimers as to Wetlands
provisions.text: 17.6 Notices and Disclaimers as to Wetlands

noRule.note: Its text is in its counted paragraphs.

provisions.label: 17.6/p1
provisions.text: "Wetlands" areas may be preserved within the Residential Community in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, and ponds and streams may be constructed or preserved during development of the Residential Community (collectively, the "Bodies of Water"), all of which may be owned either by the Association or a public or private entity. The use of the Bodies of Water by Owners shall be governed by Use Restrictions or Board Rules and Regulations, if owned by the Association, and as otherwise may be provided in another Recorded instrument, if the Bodies of Water are owned by a public or private entity. Each Owner, tenant, and resident, for himself and his family, invitees, and licensees, acknowledges, understands, and agrees that

provisions.label: 17.6(a)
provisions.text: the Bodies of Water may present a hazard to children,

noRule.note: An acknowledged risk of the Bodies of Water.

provisions.label: 17.6(b)
provisions.text: machinery operated by the Association or third parties for maintenance, safety, or other community purposes may create noise;

noRule.note: An acknowledged risk of the Bodies of Water.

provisions.label: 17.6(c)
provisions.text: the proximity to the Bodies of Water of certain Units may create additional burdens upon Owners, including, but not limited to, back yard maintenance requirements and the construction requirements for back yard fencing,

noRule.note: An acknowledged burden; the maintenance and fencing requirements themselves are in other documents.

provisions.label: 17.6(d)
provisions.text: insects associated with standing bodies of water may be present from time to time, and the existence of the Bodies of Water may cause inconvenience and disturbance and possible injury to the Owners, tenants, residents, and their families, invitees, and licensees.

noRule.note: An acknowledged risk of the Bodies of Water.

provisions.label: 17.6/p2
provisions.text: Notwithstanding the above, each Owner, tenant, and resident has considered the location of the Unit being purchased, leased, or occupied and its proximity to the Bodies of Water. By acceptance of a deed or by acquiring any interest in any of the Residential Community, each Owner, tenant, and resident, for himself and his family, invitees, and licensees, acknowledges and assumes the risks of the aforesaid nuisance, inconvenience, disturbance, damage, and possible injury to persons.

provisions.label: 17.6/p3
provisions.text: The Bodies of Water may become a component of the flood control and drainage facilities for the Residential Community, and therefore water may be diverted away from or into the Bodies of Water for that purpose. Declarant, its Affiliates, the Association, or the private or public entity owning the Bodies of Water shall not be obligated to maintain the Bodies of Water in the size, level, or formation as of the date this Declaration is Recorded where forces of nature, governmental restrictions, or the operation of flood control and drainage devices prohibit or otherwise render such maintenance of the Bodies of Water unreasonable for environmental, flood and drainage control, economic, and other reasons, as determined by such private or public entity, or with respect to any portion of the Bodies of Water owned by Declarant, its Affiliates, or the Association, by Declarant or such Affiliates in its sole discretion until Declarant and its Affiliates no longer own any Unit or other property described on Exhibits "A" or "B," and thereafter, the Association. Neither the Declarant, its Affiliates, the Association, nor any director, officer, agent, or employee of the Association shall be liable to any Owner, tenant, resident, or its family, invitees, or licensees for any claims or damages resulting, directly or indirectly, from the existence of the Bodies of Water within the Residential Community. Nothing in this Section shall be read to modify obligations imposed by any permits or approvals issued by King County or other governmental entities regarding use or development of Trilogy at Redmond Ridge, or portions thereof.

provisions.heading: Limitation of Liability
provisions.text: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Declaration, each Owner, by accepting any interest in any portion of the Residential Community and becoming an Owner, acknowledges and agrees that neither Declarant (including, without limitation, any assignee of the interest of Declarant hereunder) nor any Affiliates, partners, officers, directors, or shareholders of Declarant (or any partner of shareholder in any such assignee) shall have any personal liability to the Association, or any Owner, Member, or any other Person, arising under, in connection with, or resulting from (including, without limitation, resulting from action or failure to act with respect to) this Declaration or the Association except, in the case of Declarant (or its assignee), to the extent of its interest in the Residential Community and, in the event of a judgment, no execution or other action shall be sought or brought thereon against any other assets or be a lien upon such other assets of the judgment debtor.

provisions.label: part-seven
provisions.heading: Changes in the Residential Community
provisions.text: Communities such as Trilogy at Redmond Ridge are dynamic and constantly evolving as circumstances, technology, needs and desires, and laws change, as the residents age and change over time, and as the surrounding Residential Community changes.
